standouts.head: Buyers stepping in earlier
standouts.text: A higher low in price (Nov 23) against a lower low in momentum (5 of 7 gauges): hidden bullish divergence.
standouts.learn: Higher price lows while momentum sets lower lows: buyers stepped in earlier, a common sign the uptrend resumes.

standouts.head: Accumulation
standouts.text: In five weeks it had 4 up days and 1 down day on volume above both the day before and its average.
standouts.learn: Up days on heavy volume mean institutions are buying; heavy down days (distribution) mean they are selling.

standouts.head: 1 of the desk's strategy kind buying
standouts.text: The desk's own strategies signaled a buy: 1 kind of strategy.
standouts.learn: The desk's own trading rules; when several kinds agree on a name, the read counts it.

against.head: A thin rise
against.text: Volume on the current rise runs 31% below its 50-day average: few buyers behind it.
against.learn: A rise on heavy volume has buyers behind it; a thin rise often fades.

against.head: A pullback that is not done
against.text: The pullback from the Nov 5 high is not done: it has not reached the 0.5 retracement and it is too quick for the advance before it. A wave 2 usually unfolds in three waves and reaches the 0.618–0.786 of the Jun 22–Nov 5 advance (−21% to −27%).
against.learn: A real wave 2 takes three waves and time, on lighter volume. Too shallow, too quick, one straight leg or rising selling says it has further to go.

material.head: SPY: below its 200-day
material.text: SPY, the fund it follows, is below its 200-day average.
material.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

material.head: Uptrend on every average
material.text: Price is above its rising 50-day and 200-day averages, and the 50-day is above the 200-day.
material.learn: Both averages rising with price over them: the long trend points up.

material.head: Weekly chart: advancing
material.text: Price is above a rising 30-week average: the advancing stage.
material.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; longs pay in the advancing stage.

material.head: A higher high and a higher low
material.text: Its last swing high and swing low each topped the one before.
material.learn: Rising swing highs and lows are the steps of an uptrend.

material.head: A bull flag
material.text: It ran +24% in 12 sessions, then drifted for 8 sessions on lighter volume, giving back 40% of the run: a pause that often precedes the next leg.
material.learn: A sharp move (the pole), then a shallow drift on light volume (the flag); the next leg often matches much of the pole.
